// Fixture generator (11-13-2026, ADR-104): the vertical row of Text in Box.
// Not part of the suite: copy to tests/zz_capture.rs and run with
// OUT=<dir> cargo test --features tiles --test zz_capture -- --ignored
use stamp_tool::ImageHorseTool;

fn session(cells: (u8, u8)) -> ImageHorseTool {
    let (w, h) = (320u32, 200u32);
    let mut t = ImageHorseTool::new(w, h);
    t.load_image(&vec![240u8; (w * h * 4) as usize]);
    t.set_oplog_undo(true);
    // A boxed caption in a box far taller than its two lines, on a white fill
    // so the box shows.
    let a = t.add_text_annotation(
        "Middle of\nthe box", 18.0, 20, 20, 20, false, 20, 20, 0.0, 1, 255, 255, 255, 255, 8, 8,
        0, "",
    );
    t.recomposite();
    t.continue_step();
    t.set_text_wrap_width(a, 130);
    t.continue_step();
    t.set_text_box_height(a, 150);
    t.recomposite();
    // A second one, bottom center.
    let b = t.add_text_annotation(
        "Bottom\ncenter", 18.0, 200, 0, 0, true, 170, 20, 0.0, 1, 255, 255, 255, 255, 8, 8, 0, "",
    );
    t.recomposite();
    t.continue_step();
    t.set_text_wrap_width(b, 130);
    t.continue_step();
    t.set_text_box_height(b, 150);
    t.recomposite();
    t.set_text_align(a, cells.0);
    t.recomposite();
    t.set_text_align(b, cells.1);
    t.recomposite();
    t
}

fn write(t: &mut ImageHorseTool, out: &str) {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(out).unwrap(); // allow: rust-panic
    let n = t.oplog_op_count() as u32;
    std::fs::write(format!("{out}/frames.bin"), t.oplog_encoded_ops(0, n)).unwrap(); // allow: rust-panic
    std::fs::write(format!("{out}/annotations.bin"), t.oplog_keyframe_annotations(0)).unwrap(); // allow: rust-panic
    std::fs::write(format!("{out}/base.png"), t.oplog_keyframe_png(0)).unwrap(); // allow: rust-panic
    std::fs::write(format!("{out}/composite.rgba"), t.get_image_data()).unwrap(); // allow: rust-panic
    std::fs::write(
        format!("{out}/meta.txt"),
        format!("ops {n} cursor {} broken {} coverage {}\n{}", t.oplog_cursor(), t.oplog_is_broken(), t.oplog_coverage(), t.get_text_annotations()),
    )
    .unwrap(); // allow: rust-panic
}

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn capture() {
    let out = std::env::var("OUT").expect("OUT"); // allow: rust-panic
    // Center (cell 4) and bottom center (cell 7): the fixture.
    write(&mut session((4, 7)), &format!("{out}/rows"));
    // The same session left at top left (0, 0): only its composite is kept,
    // to show the rows moved the ink.
    write(&mut session((0, 0)), &format!("{out}/top"));
}
